meta.title: My Son Sanctuary Vietnam - Amazing Champa Temples near Hoi An | Day Trip Vlog
meta.description:
Join us on a day trip from Hoi An to the ancient My Son Sanctuary, a UNESCO World Heritage site nestled in the lush jungles of Vietnam. In this vlog, we explore the stunning red-brick temples that once served as the religious heart of the Champa Kingdom. Dating back to the 4th century, My Son is an architectural marvel dedicated to the Hindu god Shiva. We’ll dive into its fascinating history, admire the intricate carvings, and learn how this ancient site survived the test of time. This place reminded us a lot of Angkor Wat in Cambodia even though WAY smaller in size.
Whether you’re a history buff or just love exploring beautiful, hidden gems, My Son is a must-see destination. Wonder if My Son Sanctuary is worth visiting? Then keep watching! Don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more travel adventures!
